title: SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion
tagline: Immersive player thoughts for game events, status changes, and supported mods.
description:
SkyrimNet Messageless Immersion is an SKSE plugin that turns game events,
status changes, notifications, and events from supported mods into immersive
SkyrimNet player thoughts. (ASDF)

This Hub entry links to the complete mod download. The full mod is required
because it contains the native SKSE DLL, ESP, Papyrus scripts, configuration,
and SkyrimNet trigger definitions.

Download and install the latest release with your mod manager.

List of mods that may benefit to varying degrees from the plugin: YPS fashion, MME Milk mod, Advanced Nudity Detection, SLSF, Battlefuck, BodySearch, Unforgiving Devices / Unforgiving Skyrim, Devious Followers, SLAC, SL Survival 0.685 Beta SE, STA v4.8 BETA SE, The Ancient Profession, Jailrape, Licenses - Player Oppression, Apropos 2, iNeed, RND and some elements from basic Skyrim.
The detailed links can be found in the README on the GitHub page.
author: johnsonjoe1
changelog: Added constant whining feature, once hunger, thurst, fatigue or diseases have reached their worst stage.  Lots of fixes and smaller features, see full changelog on the GitHub.
